triggers.description: Owner-issued falsification evidence needs current classification.
A proposed review law must be related to accepted Goal authority.
Several observations may support one same-law observational class.
Evidence may relate to an active eliminated claim.

routes.description: Return the current analytical Review Fold.
Block when evidence, authority, applicability, provenance, or class basis is unknown.

success_signals: claims, facts, repairs, and transport status are separate
historical provenance is preserved
current applicability is judged separately
clean source is representable
failure_signals: historical evidence is rebound to the current head
unknown evidence is treated as current
durable Review Fold artifact is created
clauses.rationale: Classification remains current analysis over owner evidence.

success_signals: entailed finding may become accepted
strengthening becomes non-blocking follow-up
preference is rejected
new requirement requests Goal reopening
underdetermined requirement blocks pending authority
failure_signals: preference is treated as a bug
clauses.rationale: Review evidence may falsify accepted semantics but does not own requirements.

success_signals: duplicates collapse without erasing independent witnesses
different detection surfaces may remain one class
observed witnesses do not define the complete family
predicted siblings are distinguished from observed examples
recurrence uses exact available prior evidence
incomplete historical evidence yields unknown recurrence
failure_signals: file or reviewer identity defines a class
newly found siblings are called prior predictions
absence in incomplete history is labeled first-observed
clauses.rationale: Actuating receives bounded observational evidence rather than a retained class register.

required_artifacts: active eliminated-claim excerpt with family, validity horizon, and reconsideration falsifier when available
same-claim, same-law-different-family, outside-horizon, different-law, or unknown relation with exact basis
success_signals: current entailed same-claim relation is reported only inside the declared validity horizon
same-law disjoint families do not falsify the scoped claim
strengthening does not retroactively falsify the Goal
new requirement requests Goal reopening
Actuating retains revocation authority
failure_signals: Review Fold revokes or preserves the theory itself
post-elimination relation is inferred from memory
different-law finding is merged into the old family
same law alone revokes a family-scoped claim
out-of-horizon evidence is treated as falsifying the scoped elimination claim
clauses.rationale: Review Fold reports the falsifier relation; Actuating owns its architectural consequence.

instrumentation.rationale: The fold is returned in context; durable facts remain with source owners.
